description: Translate text to International Morse code and back. Encoding: letters separated by spaces, words by " / "; accents are folded (é → E) and characters without a code are skipped and counted. Decoding accepts . and - plus look-alikes (• · – — _), with words split by /, | or 2+ spaces; unknown codes become #. Encoding also returns the playing time at a given speed (PARIS timing: dot = 1200/WPM ms). No audio. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/morse-code/

mode.description: "encode" text → Morse, "decode" Morse → text, or "auto" (default): decode if the input only has Morse symbols, spaces, / and |.

text.description: Text to encode, or Morse code to decode.

wpm.description: Speed in words per minute for the duration estimate (default 18).

name: text_morse
title: Morse code translator
